title: Heres my web shooter game built with Claude Opus 5.5, what do you think?
author: FAAndrr
selftext:
I spent a few weeks tweaking models from chatgpt astra 6.0 and built the game's fundamental structure with claude opus 5.5, the process took about 2 weeks building and a month of polishing.

Try the game out at [paintballz.io](http://paintballz.io) !

comments.author: DogDeveloper
comments.body: I don't want to be mean

replies.author: FAAndrr
replies.body: hey man, i would appreciate some feedback even if its harsh, i can always improve you know

comments.author: ImCallingYouOutOnBS
comments.body:
Why would anybody play this over literally anything else out there? 

No, I'm not saying that to be a dick, I'm saying that as a legitimate question that a dev needs to ask themselves about their idea before a game is made. 

I see nothing in the trailer that would make me want to play this game

replies.author: FAAndrr
replies.body: Hey dude, Im in year 10 and I still play web games like [kour.io](http://kour.io) in class to cure boredom. Thanks for the question and I don't expect an adult / someone who has polished 3A games on computers to be heavily invested into the game for a reason. The game is built for middle - high schoolers sitting in class that have school systems on their laptops with restricted permissions, I know exactly what I like to do in class and its play web games, so I thought other people would too

replies.author: FAAndrr
replies.body: No like at school bro, you can't use your phones in class you do know that right

comments.author: crumbaker
comments.body:
I'll try to help you out here some.

1. Nitpick every little thing to the ai, it will fix it.  
2. Max usage will get you better animations and models. Although I've seen good results even on medium, it's going to be harder to pull off.  
3. Put yourself in a players position of having thousands upon thousands of games to choose from. What is special about yours to make them want to play it?  
4. For doing something special think weird, but good, let your brain juices flow, you can build just about anything with these models, don't limit yourself.  
5. Think of environments that are way outside of the box.  
6. Same with art style, you can find obscure artists that have long passed over 100 years ago and combine them with other artists, or combine it with something modern for example.  
7. If this is the best your brain can come up with this ain't for you, don't limit yourself and take some time to flesh out ideas.
